_comment: Readiness policy for §5.1 criteria. Values are policy choices, not data-derived constants; each carries its rationale so a reviewer can challenge the number itself.

stock_turnover.rationale: Turnover feeds the §3.1 liquidity screen, the §7 execution-capacity cap and the §10.3 unexecutable-order ratio. A backtest may be limited to the covered subset, but a subset too thin to fill 25 holdings with industry diversification cannot support those metrics. 0.20 with an absolute floor of 200 covered securities is a policy floor, chosen to be reachable with current sources while forcing the uncovered remainder to be declared; it is not derived from the data.
stock_turnover.remainder_rule: Securities without turnover are excluded from selection and must appear in the backtest conclusion as an explicit scope limitation.

etf_turnover.rationale: The ETF sleeve holds at most 3 products chosen by index de-duplication, so its universe is far smaller than the stock one and full coverage is not the goal. It still needs enough candidates that rotation is a choice rather than a forced pick, and enough indices that de-duplication has something to de-duplicate. 30 covered products against the registered ETF universe is the floor; the six products registered so far fall below it by a wide margin, which is the honest answer.
etf_turnover.remainder_rule: ETFs without turnover cannot enter rotation; the backtest conclusion must state which products were actually available.
